title: Convex Hull
statement: Given a set of $n$ points, your task is to find the convex hull of the points.
inputFormat:
The first input line has an integer $n$: the number of points.
After this, there are $n$ lines that describe the points. Each line has two integers $x$ and $y$.
outputFormat:
First print an integer $k$: the number of points in the convex hull.
Then print $k$ lines that describe the points.
